verdict.rationale: Lium's own docs disclose some data-handling facts: pod volumes are encrypted at rest by default on the default templates, and local volumes are backed up every 6 hours and kept for 2 days. These cover only a thin slice of the story's security-posture question. missing for 10: SOC 2 or other compliance attestations, a trust/security center or published data-handling policy, datacenter tier and provider vetting information for marketplace hosts, and independent corroboration.
